name: mstack
description: Rigorous engineering workflows, reusable principles, and multi-model review for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Design consequential changes, implement them in verifiable units, investigate rationale, challenge code with independent models, and apply reusable engineering principles.
defaultPrompt: Use $setup-mstack to configure model assignments for my available harnesses.
Use $implement to make this change in small, verified units.
Use $architect to design this change without implementing it.
Use $interrogate to run an adversarial review of these changes.
